scripts.build: npm run build:html && npm run build:pdf
scripts.build:pdf: RESUME_PUPPETEER_NO_SANDBOX=1 resume export --theme jsonresume-theme-macea resume.pdf && npm run trim
scripts.trim: python3 trim_pdf.py resume.pdf resume_temp.pdf && mv resume_temp.pdf resume.pdf
scripts.build:profile: resume export --resume profiles/$PROFILE/resume.json --theme ${THEME:-jsonresume-theme-macea} profiles/$PROFILE/resume.html && RESUME_PUPPETEER_NO_SANDBOX=1 resume export --resume profiles/$PROFILE/resume.json --theme ${THEME:-jsonresume-theme-macea} profiles/$PROFILE/resume.pdf && python3 trim_pdf.py profiles/$PROFILE/resume.pdf profiles/$PROFILE/resume_temp.pdf && mv profiles/$PROFILE/resume_temp.pdf profiles/$PROFILE/resume.pdf
scripts.preview: npm run build && npm run serve
